message:
Thanks for the good words, everyone.

Joanna, I'm celebrating by taking a break from the academic reading and enjoying [Kelly Link's](http://www.kellylink.net/) collection of short fiction, *[Magic for Beginners](http://www.lcrw.net/kellylink/mfb/index.htm)*. It's brilliant, incredible, wonderful, and it's got illustrations by the equally brilliant [Shelley Jackson](http://www.ineradicablestain.com/iswho.html), who wrote [Patchwork Girl](http://www.eastgate.com/catalog/PatchworkGirl.html). One of the stories, "Stone Animals," was in the *Best American Short Stories* Michael Chabon edited last year.

And I had no idea that she lives 8 miles down the road from me in Northampton, Massachusetts. I wonder if we've crossed paths at the Stop & Shop on King Street, or at Raven or Haymarket.
